verdict.rationale: Canva offers Connect APIs, an Admin API, and an official MCP server, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the pack describes issuing scoped or least-privilege tokens, OAuth scopes, or per-agent credential controls. Team-app distribution controls (who can use an app) and Enterprise-only private integrations concern app access, not credential scoping, so they don't count here.
